secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key from your Clerk dashboard (https://dashboard.clerk.com). Required for authentication to work.

secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk secret key from your Clerk dashboard (https://dashboard.clerk.com). Required for authentication to work.

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Secret used to sign/verify legacy JWT tokens. Any random string works for local dev.

secrets.name: BLUE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: App secret for the 'blue' verification check. Any random string works for local dev.

secrets.name: CREATION_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: App secret for creation flow validation. Any random string works for local dev.

secrets.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key from your Turnstile dashboard. Optional — human challenge runs in dry-run mode without it.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key from your Turnstile dashboard. Optional — human challenge runs in dry-run mode without it.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL. Optional — file storage defaults to local mode without it.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key. Optional — file storage defaults to local mode without it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for server-side storage uploads. Optional — file storage defaults to local mode without it.
